description: A saved territory's latest written quarterly brief, whole or one section: each section's takeaway, its findings, and the surgeons it features with the brief's note on each (why now, how to approach them). Sections: what_changed, account_universe (who does the cases), relationship_depth (which companies are engaged, how deeply), movement, market (where it is going), evidence, next_steps (where to spend the week). Every figure in it was checked against MedaRep's data tools. Use it first for strategy, approach and "what should I do" questions about a saved territory; then live tools for what is newer than writtenAt.

section.description: One section by key or title word, e.g. market, relationship_depth, next_steps; omit for the whole brief.

territory.description: A saved territory's name (as my_territories lists it) or id.

name: territory_brief
title: My territory's written brief
